description: Lawh.ai turns a description into a real, layered design file in the user's own account rather than a flat image. It measures the text, computes the layout, prevents clipping, and reports layout or contrast problems so they can be fixed. Designs can be listed, previewed as images, opened in an interactive view where layers are dragged and text retyped, started from a hand-authored template library, organised into folders, and built with the user's own uploaded logos and images. Arabic and right-to-left layouts are supported natively. Finished work stays editable in the browser and exports as a layered Photoshop file with live text.
